nodes.name: List all workflows
nodes.notes: Calls this same n8n instance's own REST API — n8n workflows can reach n8n's own API this way, no separate service needed. Set N8N_API_KEY as an n8n environment variable (Settings > API) before activating.

nodes.name: Deactivate it
nodes.notes: The actual enforcement point: a workflow missing its required gate call gets shut off, not just flagged. This is what makes the gate structural rather than a convention someone has to remember.
